# Sonic Search
> Natural-language search over the 35-track CWI catalog — real measured audio features, transparent scoring, honest coverage labels.

Brief-first natural-language search over 35 catalog tracks. 6/35 tracks carry real measured audio features (ReccoBeats third-party analysis 2026-09-16); the other 29 match on editorial mood tags only and wear an honest 'no audio features on file — tag match only' label. Nothing is ever estimated.

## Live
- App: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-sonic-search/
- Try it: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-sonic-search/?q=dark%20trap%20fight%20scene

## Features
- AIMS-style brief box + Cyanite-style numeric chips
- Transparent value-cited score breakdowns
- Honest coverage labels on every result
- ?q= deep links + ?q=&format=json machine-readable payload (cwi.sonic-result/1.0)
- One-stop clearance via hp@cumulativeweb.com (neutral chip)
- 26/26 tests

## Machine-readable
- sample_query: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-sonic-search/?q=dark%20trap%20fight%20scene
- json_api: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-sonic-search/?q=dark%20trap&format=json
- schema: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-sonic-search/results.schema.json

## Honest limits
Audio features exist for 6/35 tracks only; the rest are tag-only matches, labeled as such. Never estimates audio features.

## Provider
Cumulative Web Inc — hp@cumulativeweb.com
